# Sales Analysis: January–June 2026

**Method:** Each order's value is quantity × unit price × (1 − discount%). Net revenue includes only orders with status "Completed".

---

### q1. Net revenue in March 2026

All 27 March orders (SO-2049 to SO-2075) are Completed. Their values add up to **£16,983.75**.

---

### q2. Region with the highest net revenue in Q2 (April–June)

| Region | Q2 net revenue |
|---|---|
| **East** | **£6,603.70** |
| South | £4,616.60 |
| West | £4,528.25 |
| North | £3,668.65 |

**East** had the highest net revenue.

---

### q3. Product growth from Q1 to Q2

| Product | Q1 | Q2 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standing Desk | £12,180.00 | £6,405.00 | −47.4% |
| Filing Cabinet | £10,620.00 | £2,052.00 | −80.7% |
| Desk Chair | £8,903.00 | £4,444.25 | −50.1% |
| **Whiteboard** | **£4,617.00** | **£3,377.25** | **−26.9%** |
| Monitor Arm | £5,408.00 | £1,651.00 | −69.5% |
| Desk Lamp | £3,592.90 | £1,487.70 | −58.6% |

⚠️ **No product grew.** Every product's net revenue fell from Q1 to Q2. The best performer was **Whiteboard**, which had the smallest decline at **−26.9%**.

---

### q5. Top customer by net revenue (January–June)

| Customer | Net revenue |
|---|---|
| **Copperfield Law** | **£7,222.40** |
| Linden Travel | £6,637.95 |
| Elmwood Primary School | £6,151.30 |
| Oakridge Media | £5,906.50 |

**Copperfield Law** had the highest net revenue.

---

### q6. Average net order value in Q1

- Q1 net revenue: £45,320.90
- Completed orders in Q1: 68 (75 orders, minus 7 refunded or cancelled)
- Average: £45,320.90 ÷ 68 = **£666.48**
